# Ethaion

> An AI wardrobe advisor for timeless menswear. Beau, the in-app valet, learns a
> customer's proportions, taste and wardrobe gaps, then does the searching so
> they can buy with conviction.

Ethaion is a private web app. Customers enter with an email address and build a
digital wardrobe: photographing garments they own, recording fit and sizing, and
receiving daily outfit suggestions based on real weather and occasion. Most
functionality sits behind the email gate and is not publicly crawlable.

## What Ethaion does

- Digital wardrobe — photograph owned garments; each catalogued with fabric, fit, season and occasion
- Beau — an AI advisor that recommends outfits and sources new pieces against a stored taste profile
- The Dossier — measurements, proportions, archetypes and brand sizing in one place
- The Fitting — daily outfit composition using live weather and the customer's own wardrobe
- Maker Scout — discovery of makers and garments matched to the customer's profile

## Notes for agents

- The public site is a marketing page and an email gate; the application requires a session
- Customer wardrobes, measurements and taste profiles are private and per-session
